filings.ai_summary: enCore Energy Corp. announced its second quarter 2026 financial results on August 13, 2026.
enCore Energy Corp. plans to sell up to $250 million in common shares through an "at the market" offering.
Encore Energy Corp. reported a net loss of $41.4 million for the second quarter of 2026, compared to a loss of $6.3 million in the prior year.
enCore Energy Corp. terminated CEO Robert J. Willette.
enCore Energy Corp. shareholders approved all matters at the June 10, 2026, Annual General Meeting, including director elections and executive compensation.
